description: This file contains implementation of commit graph traversal, merge base computations, commit ancestry checks, and related algorithms for a git repository. It handles complex git commit operations such as reachability, redundancy removal, sorting by generation, and minimal branch point detection.

methods.name: int compare_commits_by_gen(const void * _a,const void * _b)
methods.description: Compares two commits based on generation number and date for sorting purposes.

methods.name: int queue_has_nonstale(struct prio_queue * queue)
methods.description: Checks if the priority queue contains any commits that are not marked as stale.

methods.name: int paint_down_to_common(struct repository * r,struct commit * one,int n,struct commit ** twos,timestamp_t min_generation,int ignore_missing_commits,struct commit_list ** result)
methods.description: Performs a traversal from given commits down to a common ancestor, marking reachable commits and handling missing commits based on flags.

methods.name: int merge_bases_many(struct repository * r,struct commit * one,int n,struct commit ** twos,struct commit_list ** result)
methods.description: Finds merge bases among multiple commits, combining the results from various paths.

methods.name: int get_octopus_merge_bases(struct commit_list * in,struct commit_list ** result)
methods.description: Computes the merge bases among multiple commits for octopus merges.

methods.name: int repo_get_merge_bases_many(struct repository * r,struct commit * one,size_t n,struct commit ** twos,struct commit_list ** result)
methods.description: Wrapper function to obtain multiple merge bases between a commit and multiple other commits.

methods.name: int repo_get_merge_bases_many_dirty(struct repository * r,struct commit * one,size_t n,struct commit ** twos,struct commit_list ** result)
methods.description: Similar to above but pulling out intermediate cleanup steps and ignoring missing commits.

methods.name: int repo_get_merge_bases(struct repository * r,struct commit * one,struct commit * two,struct commit_list ** result)
methods.description: Finds common merge bases between two commits.

methods.name: int repo_is_descendant_of(struct repository * r,struct commit * commit,struct commit_list * with_commit)
methods.description: Checks if a commit is a descendant of another commit or of any in a list.

methods.name: int repo_in_merge_bases_many(struct repository * r,struct commit * commit,int nr_reference,struct commit ** reference,int ignore_missing_commits)
methods.description: Determines if a commit is reachable from any of several references.

methods.name: int repo_in_merge_bases(struct repository * r,struct commit * commit,struct commit * reference)
methods.description: Checks if one commit is reachable from another.

methods.name: struct:commit_list * reduce_heads(struct commit_list * heads)
methods.description: Reduces a list of heads to the minimal set of independent heads.

methods.name: void reduce_heads_replace(struct commit_list ** heads)
methods.description: Replaces the list of heads with their reduced set.

methods.name: int ref_newer(const struct object_id * new_oid,const struct object_id * old_oid)
methods.description: Determines if a new commit is newer than an old commit based on ancestry.

methods.name: void tips_reachable_from_bases(struct repository * r,struct commit_list * bases,struct commit ** tips,size_t tips_nr,int mark)
methods.description: Marks tips that are reachable from a set of base commits.

methods.name: int get_branch_base_for_tip(struct repository * r,struct commit * tip,struct commit ** bases,size_t bases_nr)
methods.description: Identifies the best common ancestor (branch point) for a tip and its bases.

methods.name: int commit_contains(struct ref_filter * filter,struct commit * commit,struct commit_list * list,struct contains_cache * cache)
methods.description: Checks if a commit contains others, either via tags or ancestry.

methods.name: int can_all_from_reach(struct commit_list * from,struct commit_list * to,int cutoff_by_min_date)
methods.description: Verifies whether all commits from a list are reachable from another list.

methods.name: int can_all_from_reach_with_flag(struct object_array * from,unsigned int with_flag,unsigned int assign_flag,timestamp_t min_commit_date,timestamp_t min_generation)

methods.name: struct:commit_list * get_reachable_subset(struct commit ** from,size_t nr_from,struct commit ** to,size_t nr_to,unsigned int reachable_flag)
methods.description: Finds subset of commits reachable from one set, but not from another, using traversal algorithms.
